name: bmw
description: BMWVideo, browser and media native Agent (BMW)

scripts.start: npm run build --silent && node scripts/start-electron.js bmw
scripts.test:media-e2e: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/media-capture-smoke.js
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-source.ts && npm run check:features
scripts.test:desktop-e2e: npm run build --silent && node scripts/run-electron-script.js scripts/desktop-smoke.js
